note: KLHL20 variants are documented to cause a neurodevelopmental syndrome with developmental delay, intellectual disability, seizures/epilepsy, and dysmorphic features.

evidence.text: Sleyp et al. evaluated 14 patients with de novo KLHL20 missense variants, delineating a neurodevelopmental syndrome characterized by mild to severe intellectual disability, early global developmental delay, febrile seizures or epilepsy, and subtle facial dysmorphisms.

source.title: De novo missense variants in the E3 ubiquitin ligase adaptor KLHL20 cause a developmental disorder with intellectual disability, epilepsy, and autism spectrum …
source.quote: We studied 14 patients with de novo missense variants in KLHL20, delineating a genetic syndrome with patients having mild to severe intellectual disability, febrile seizures or epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, hyperactivity, and subtle dysmorphic facial features.
